chatCommands./agent: Shows Codex and Claude Code, then the selected agent's model catalog.
chatCommands./model: Changes only the current Product Chat agent's model.
chatCommands./advisor: Preserved as the combined agent-and-model compatibility selector.
chatCommands./status: Reports the current Product Chat agent, model, model truth class, draft phase, and progress.

implemented.sidebar: The GAEP Agent view exposes Product Chat Agent and Advisory Model as independent selectable rows backed by the same workspace-scoped session.
implemented.session: The advisory selection is stored in VS Code workspaceState, keyed by selected Product root. It is machine-local, contains no executable path, and is not written to .gaep.
implemented.pendingSwitch: An in-Chat switch during an unaccepted proposal re-evaluates the original candidate with the new agent/model. The Product step remains unchanged; only /accept advances.
implemented.availability: Both supported agents remain visible. An unavailable agent shows a reason plus Configure Executable and Diagnostics recovery actions instead of disappearing.
implemented.codexDiscovery: On macOS the host honors an explicit machine setting, then PATH, then the regular Codex executable distributed in the official ChatGPT desktop application. No path enters portable state.

liveProbe.claimBoundary: Probe verifies the local executable/interface/catalog contract only; it is not a provider request or account entitlement claim.

verification.extensionHost: passed: activation, exact command contribution/registration, native views, multi-root, VSIX upgrade/reinstall/rollback/uninstall/final install, installed-package activation, and no implicit workspace mutation

remaining: Product Owner confirmation that /agent visibly lists both local agents
